程序包 org.bukkit.block.data.type

接口 CreakingHeart

所有超级接口:
BlockData, java.lang.Cloneable, Orientable
public interface CreakingHeart extends Orientable
'creaking_heart_state' 表示方块当前的运行阶段.
'natural' 表示这是否是自然生成的方块.

原文： 'creaking_heart_state' is the state of the block depending on the time and its position.
'natural' is whether this is a naturally generated block.
